description: The registered process returns an accepted job receipt in data.job_id and data.status=queued. Retain that exact canonical id and read service_interface::job_service::get_job until terminal. The stored job.result is the original operation envelope, including data and structured error; job.error is also retained on failure. A receipt does not establish a session, dispatch row, or successful first turn. launch_busy names the current operation/job and starts no work. Runs a bounded real no-worktree qualification worker through the qualification host. It proves fleet plumbing, not an LLM runtime.
embedding_description: Submit a bounded session-launch job; retrieve its result by exact job id. Qualify fleet plumbing with a synthetic worker through the declared qualification host: await real watch-bridge registration, claim its durable role with the registered identity, verify role-addressed delivery to that instance, release the role, and retire the worker without a branch or worktree.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Accepted submission only: data.job_id and data.status=queued. After terminal retrieval, job.result.data carries the original operation fields; job.result.error preserves its error. Continue dependent actions only after this retrieval.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report acceptance with job_id. Retrieve the terminal job before reporting an instance, dispatch state, first-turn outcome, or qualification verdict. Keep uptake_pending and uptake_uncertain distinct from worker ACK.
